contribution.position: On reliability the evidence is unfavorable as it stands. Cold_start measured 1900ms at peak load against an 800ms budget, about 2.4x over, so the change misses a stated performance bound at the point where the warmer matters most. The incident log shows two sev2 incidents last quarter, both from retry storms. A slow cold start at peak is the kind of condition that can trigger retries, so the existing failure mode may be amplified. The passing tests (412 passed, 0 failed, 87% coverage) show functional correctness but say nothing about behavior under peak load or retry pressure, so they do not offset the perf gap. Needed before this axis could support the change: a load test showing cold_start within budget, or a documented waiver for the overage, and evidence of retry and backoff behavior under peak load that rules out a repeat of the retry-storm incidents. The runbook's documented rollback (v4) reduces recovery cost but does not prevent the failure.
